scoring_policy.detail: Each fully accepted criterion contributes 1 point. For reviewed but unaccepted items, each independently documented technical gate contributes 1/N point, capped below 1 until official acceptance. Unreviewed items remain unscored, not claimed to be 0% implemented. All 23 criteria have equal weight for this indicator; this is not an effort, SLA, readiness-for-sales, or release metric.
scoring_policy.no_double_count: An officially accepted item must not appear under reviewed_partial_gates.
scoring_policy.caveat: The technical indicator is a conservative evidence floor, not objective global completion and must never replace the formal acceptance denominator.
